resources.string: Convert BC textures in RPF archives and nested resources. Output is for custom games with ASTC support. Dynamic textures and unsupported formats are retained and reported.
Each archive is replaced after verification. Stopping preserves archives already completed. Keep your original BC files if you may need to change compression settings later.
Fix invalid page sizes in older converted resources. Texture payloads stay unchanged; damaged colors require conversion from the original BC files.

Alpha weighting is for transparent color textures. Leave it disabled for normals and masks. These settings apply to every converted texture. Higher quality takes longer and does not change the block size.
Require zero remaining BC before replacing an archive
Keep original resources on error and continue
Partial estimate: some resources were not scanned.
Scan to compare all 14 block sizes. Estimates include mip levels, layers and whole blocks; they exclude retained textures, page padding and archive compression. Scan again after source files change.
Textures: %1$d · BC remaining: %2$d · Blocked: %3$d · Repaired resources: %4$d · Errors: %5$d
The task can continue in the background. Stopping leaves completed archives in place; a new copy may be incomplete.
Finished with retained BC or errors
Android stopped this background task at its time limit. Completed archives are preserved. Run again to continue.
The previous task was interrupted. The next run will check any pending replacement before continuing. Completed archives are preserved.
